## Summary

What makes a social-media post perform well? This study trains machine-learning classifiers on visual features (such as color complexity and sharpness) and temporal features to predict Instagram engagement.

## Contribution

- Quantifies how color complexity and image sharpness relate to engagement.
- Demonstrates a reproducible machine-learning classification pipeline for social media analytics.
